title: Looking for playtesters
author: HexBreach
selftext:
Hey everyone, long time lurker first time poster.

Ive always loved RTS games but I am absolutely trash at them so I decided to make something similar thats quick 2-4 minute matches. Give it a shot and let me know what you think, Ill try to answer any questions as soon as possible but I do work full time.

Ill admit this is still very young, I'll be reworking all of the audio, adding 2 new races, and much more is slated for expansion but someone in a dev group said that building without feedback is the wrong way to make a game. 

So that brings me here, give it a shot, email me any feedback or comment it on here. 

hexbreachgame@gmail.com
